# Design Handoff: Calendar Event Popup
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

## Result

The approved refinement reuses the existing calendar event payload, shadcn/Radix `Dialog`, `is_admin` Inertia prop, and administrator callbacks. No new route, endpoint, data field, or authorization rule is required.

## Interaction

| User action | Result |
|---|---|
| Click desktop event marker | Open the selected event in the modal |
| Click mobile event row | Open the selected event in the modal |
| Close the modal | Return to the calendar without changing event data |
| Administrator selects Edit | Close the detail modal and open the existing event edit form |
| Administrator selects Delete | Use the existing confirmation and protected delete request |
| Participant opens an event | Show event details without Edit or Delete actions |

## Traceability

| Requirement | Design coverage |
|---|---|
| RQ-14 (The application should provide a calendar with scheduled events and configurable email reminders) | Popup event details, optional location and broadcast link, and existing calendar event actions |
| RQ-08 (The application must work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices) | Desktop markers and mobile event rows both open the same responsive modal |
| RQ-10 (Protected routes, APIs, and files must enforce server-side access controls) | `is_admin` controls presentation; existing `admin` middleware remains the mutation boundary |
